description: This file contains a utility function 'formatLabel' that formats object keys (typically in snake_case or underscored) into human-readable labels with proper capitalization and acronym handling. It is meant for UI display purposes, converting internal JSON keys into a display-friendly format.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts a snake_case or underscored label into Title Case with spaces, handling common acronyms and ensuring the original data remains unaltered.
